title: Cold-transcript trim liveness counts file-change tracking Arcs held by pending state cuts
outcome: The cold-transcript trim decision tells a live watcher capture of a session's file-change tracking apart from a copy held only by a pending immutable state cut, so a pending cut no longer delays trimming.
acceptance: The cold-transcript trim decision no longer reads Arc::strong_count of the record's file_change_tracking as evidence of a live watcher capture; a copy held only by a pending immutable state cut does not hold the session resident.
A test shows a session whose row is retained by a pending state cut, with no live capture and a closed grace window, is trimmed; and one with a live capture is still retried.
